title: Mammalian Cell Culture: Subculturing
author: Kenneth Schackart
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.3q4gmyw

steps.title: Assess Cell Confluency
steps.instruction: Examine cells under a light microscope to estimate the percentage of surface covered by cells to determine if subculturing is necessary.

steps.title: Wash Cells
steps.instruction: Wash the cells twice using DPBS.

substeps.instruction: Add 4 mL DPBS to flask (1 mL for T-25) using a serological pipette.
Remove DPBS using a serological pipette and dispose into a waste beaker.
Repeat these two actions a second time.

steps.title: Detach Cells with Trypsin-EDTA
steps.instruction: Add warmed trypsin-EDTA to the flask to detach cells.

substeps.instruction: Add 4 mL warmed trypsin-EDTA to the flask (1 mL for T-25).
Wait approximately 5 minutes for detachment; if cells take longer (up to 15 minutes), monitor progress via light microscope or place the flask in an incubator to maintain temperature.

steps.title: Neutralize Trypsin
steps.instruction: Neutralize the trypsin-EDTA by adding an equal volume of cell culture media.

substeps.instruction: Add 4 mL cell culture media (1 mL for T-25).

steps.title: Collect and Centrifuge Cells
steps.instruction: Transfer the cell suspension and centrifuge to pellet the cells.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the cell suspension (cells, trypsin-EDTA, and media) into a 15 mL centrifuge tube using a serological pipette.

steps.title: Remove Supernatant
steps.instruction: Carefully remove the supernatant from the centrifuge tube without disturbing the cell pellet.

substeps.instruction: Remove the bulk of the supernatant using a serological pipette and dispose into a waste beaker.
Use a 1000 μL pipette to carefully remove the remaining supernatant.

steps.title: Resuspend Cell Pellet
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in cell culture media.

substeps.instruction: Add 1000 µL cell culture media to the cell pellet and let sit for 1 minute.
Gently pipette mix the pellet by slowly drawing the solution in and pushing it out several times without removing the tip from the solution until resuspended.

steps.title: Prepare Flasks and Seed Cells
steps.instruction: Prepare the flasks and seed the resuspended cells.

substeps.instruction: Add 9.5 mL fresh cell culture media to a T-25 flask to preserve remaining cells.
Seed 2 flasks with 500 µL of cell suspension each (or more flasks with smaller volumes).

steps.title: Incubate and Label
steps.instruction: Incubate the seeded flasks and update documentation.

substeps.instruction: Incubate at 37 °C in a CO2 incubator.
Label the flask with the date and updated passage number.
